_comment: Oracle probes: guest functions recorded on BOTH sides and diffed.
This is the ONE place a probe is declared. tools/gen_probes.py turns it
into every consumer -- the shared C table, the port's __wrap_ hooks, the
link flags that make those hooks fire, and the --isolate entries without
which ld --wrap binds at compile time and silently never fires (the same
trap src/native/overrides.json documents).
A probe names a function by its QUALIFIED name, not an address. The
generator resolves it against scratch/recomp/<module>.json and refuses if
the name is absent or ambiguous, so a probe cannot quietly point at the
wrong code after a re-export.
Fields:
at    'ecx'        the __thiscall this-pointer
'arg<N>'     the Nth stack argument at entry, counting from 0
read  'dword'      record the value itself
<n>          record n bytes AT that address
when  'in'         captured before the call (arguments)
'out'        captured after it (what the function wrote), using
the ENTRY value of ecx/esp, so a clobbered register
does not move the field
Sizes are the guest's: igQuaternionf is 16 bytes (x,y,z,w) and
igMatrix44f is 64 (four rows of four floats).

probes.name: Gap::Math::igQuaternionf::slerp
probes.why: Spherical interpolation between animation keyframes. A slerp that loses normalisation is the shortest path from correct keyframes to a non-rigid bone matrix (issue #80).

probes.name: Gap::Math::igQuaternionf::lerp
probes.why: The cheap interpolation beside slerp; the engine picks between them, so both are on the animation path.

probes.name: Gap::Math::igQuaternionf::normalize
probes.why: In-place, and the one function whose whole job is the unit length the measured palette had lost. FDIVR against a memory operand: if the reversed divide were translated the wrong way round the quaternion would be scaled by its length instead of divided by it.

probes.name: Gap::Math::igQuaternionf::getMatrix
probes.why: Quaternion to 4x4. Where a non-unit quaternion becomes the non-rigid matrix that constcmp.py measured, and also where a mistranslated FSUBR would put the diagonal 2(y^2+z^2)-1 instead of 1-2(y^2+z^2).

probes.name: Gap::Math::igQuaternionf::multiply
probes.why: Quaternion composition, used to concatenate joint rotations. Dense x87 with FSUBP and FADD ST0,ST1 over a deep stack.

probes.name: Gap::Math::igMatrix44f::multiplyAligned
probes.why: The bone concatenation itself. Dispatches through the CPUID-selected pointer at 0x1008a3c8, so this also shows WHICH backend each side chose: two sides that disagree here disagree about that.

probes.name: Gap::Math::igMatrix44f::setQuaternion
probes.why: The other quaternion-to-matrix entry point; the palette builder may use either.
